beats.say: No VALORANT team had ever won Champions twice. Until LOUD.
LOUD beat Team Vitality three maps to one in the grand final, at the Mercedes-Benz Arena in Shanghai.
So why does this one matter so much?
LOUD's first Champions title came back in 2022. No other organisation has ever won a second.
And the tournament MVP was LOUD's own Roberto Lobos, known to fans as erde.
Every other champion has won it once. Only LOUD has won it twice.
